name: offprompt
tagline: Hand Cline an API key without the key entering the chat
description:
When a task needs an API key, a token or a password, Cline calls offprompt instead of asking you to paste it into the chat. A page opens in your browser on `127.0.0.1`, checks each value as you paste it against what offprompt knows of the provider's keys, and writes it into the project's `.env` or another file. Cline gets back the key names and a four-emoji fingerprint, never the values, so they stay out of the model's context and the transcript.

No account or API key of its own. MIT licensed, and it collects no telemetry.

install.notes: Needs Node.js 22 or later. In the VS Code extension, add `"cwd"` with your project's absolute path next to `command` in offprompt's entry in `cline_mcp_settings.json`: Cline names no project to the servers it starts, and offprompt writes only inside one. The Cline CLI starts the server in the folder it runs in and needs no `cwd`.
